title: Full stock analysis
description: Senior-analyst read on a stock's fundamentals with a buy/hold/sell call.
text: Act as a senior Wall Street analyst. Analyze [stock ticker] covering revenue
growth, profit margins, debt levels, competitive position, and valuation.
Give me a clear buy, hold, or sell recommendation with reasoning.

title: Build a stock screener
description: Generate concrete filter criteria for finding stocks that match a strategy.
text: Create a stock screening criteria list for finding [growth / dividend / value]
stocks. Include the exact financial metrics, ratios, and thresholds I should
filter by to find high-quality opportunities in [sector/market].

title: Stock purchase timing
description: Get a read on whether to buy now, wait, or set a target entry price.
text: I want to buy [stock ticker] but want to enter at the best possible price.
Analyze its current valuation, recent price action, and key support levels
to tell me whether to buy now, wait for a pullback, or set a specific

title: Assess stock risk
description: Surface the downside scenarios and vulnerabilities behind a position.
text: Analyze the downside risk of investing in [stock ticker]. Cover industry
threats, competitive risks, balance sheet vulnerabilities, macro exposure,
and the realistic worst-case scenario for this position.

title: Compare two stocks
description: Head-to-head read on two tickers for a given investing style and horizon.
text: Compare [stock A] vs [stock B] for a [growth / income / value] investor with
a [timeframe] horizon. Analyze valuation, growth trajectory, financial health,
and competitive moat. Tell me which is the stronger buy and why.
